title: Matrix Chain Multiplication
description: Find the most efficient way to multiply a given sequence of matrices using interval DP in O(N^3).

title: Edit Distance
description: Given two strings word1 and word2, return minimum edit operations to convert word1 to word2.

title: Subset Sum Problem (Partition Equal Subset Sum)
description: Determine if array can be partitioned into two subsets such that the sum of elements in both subsets is equal.

title: Friends Pairing Problem
description: Count total ways to pair up n friends where each friend can remain single or pair up with another friend.

title: Gold Mine Problem
description: Find maximum gold miner can collect starting from any row in first column moving right, right-up, or right-down.

title: Assembly Line Scheduling Problem
description: Find minimum time to build product on two assembly lines with workstation and transfer costs.

title: Painting the Fence problem
description: Count ways to paint fence with n posts using k colors such that no more than two adjacent posts have same color.

title: Maximize The Cut Segments
description: Find maximum number of cut segments of lengths x, y, and z into which rod of length N can be cut.

title: Longest Common Subsequence
description: Given two strings, return the length of their longest common subsequence.

title: Longest Repeated Subsequence
description: Find the length of longest subsequence that appears at least twice without using same character index.

title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
description: Find length of longest strictly increasing subsequence in O(N log N) using patience sorting and binary search.

title: Space Optimized Solution of LCS
description: Compute LCS length using only two rows of dynamic programming table in O(min(N, M)) space.

title: LCS (Longest Common Subsequence) of three strings
description: Find length of longest common subsequence of three given strings using 3D dynamic programming.

title: Maximum Sum Increasing Subsequence
description: Find maximum sum of a subsequence such that all elements in subsequence are sorted in strictly increasing order.

title: Count all subsequences having product less than K
description: Find number of non-empty subsequences of positive integers having product strictly less than K.

title: Longest subsequence such that difference between adjacent is one
description: Find the length of longest subsequence where absolute difference between consecutive elements is 1.

title: Maximum subsequence sum such that no three are consecutive
description: Find maximum sum subsequence from array such that no three elements picked are adjacent.

title: Egg Dropping Puzzle
description: Find minimum number of moves required to determine critical floor using k eggs and n floors.

title: Maximum Length Chain of Pairs
description: Find the longest chain of pairs (a, b) and (c, d) where b < c using greedy sorting or DP.

title: Maximal Square (Maximum size square sub-matrix with all 1s)
description: Find the largest square containing only 1s in a binary matrix and return its area.

title: Maximum sum of pairs with specific difference
description: Pair elements such that difference is strictly less than K to maximize total sum of paired elements.

title: Min Cost Path Problem
description: Find a path from top left to bottom right of m x n grid which minimizes sum of all numbers along its path.

title: Maximum difference of zeros and ones in binary string
description: Find substring with maximum (count of 0s - count of 1s) by converting 0 to +1 and 1 to -1 using Kadane.

title: Jump Game II (Minimum number of jumps to reach end)
description: Return minimum number of jumps to reach last index of nums in O(N) time using greedy interval BFS.

title: Minimum cost to fill given weight in a bag
description: Find minimum cost to buy exactly W kg of oranges given costs of 1kg, 2kg, ... packets using unbounded knapsack.

title: Minimum removals from array to make max - min <= K
description: Find minimum removals from array so that difference between max and min remaining elements is at most K.

title: Longest Common Substring
description: Find length of the longest contiguous substring common to both given strings S1 and S2.

title: Count number of ways to reach a given score in a game
description: Count number of distinct combinations to reach score n using point moves 3, 5, and 10.

title: Count Balanced Binary Trees of Height h
description: Count number of balanced binary trees of height h: dp[h] = dp[h-1]*(2*dp[h-2] + dp[h-1]) mod 10^9+7.

title: Largest sum contiguous subarray (Kadane's Algorithm)
description: Find contiguous subarray with maximum sum in O(N) time and O(1) space.

title: Smallest sum contiguous subarray
description: Find contiguous subarray with smallest sum using modified Kadane's algorithm.

title: Unbounded Knapsack (Repetition of items allowed)
description: Maximize total value in knapsack where unlimited copies of each item are available.

title: Word Break Problem (DP)
description: Determine if string s can be segmented into space-separated sequence of dictionary words using 1D DP.

title: Largest Independent Set Problem
description: Find size of largest subset of vertices in binary tree such that no two vertices are adjacent.

title: Partition Equal Subset Sum
description: Check whether array can be partitioned into two subsets of equal sum.

title: Longest Palindromic Subsequence
description: Find the length of the longest palindromic subsequence in string s using LCS(s, rev(s)).

title: Count Palindromic Subsequences
description: Count all palindromic subsequences in string modulo 10^9+7 using 2D DP.

title: Longest Palindromic Substring (DP approach)
description: Find the longest contiguous palindromic substring using boolean DP table.

title: Longest alternating subsequence (Wiggle Subsequence)
description: Return length of longest subsequence where differences between successive elements strictly alternate between positive and negative.

title: Weighted Job Scheduling
description: Find maximum profit non-overlapping subset of jobs using sorting, binary search, and dynamic programming in O(N log N).

title: Coin game winner where every player has three choices
description: Determine winner of game where players can pick 1, x, or y coins in each turn using game-theory DP.

title: Count Derangements
description: Count permutations of n elements where no element appears in its original position: d(n) = (n-1)*(d(n-1) + d(n-2)).

title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock IV (At most K transactions)
description: Find maximum profit from stock prices completing at most k transactions.

title: Find minimum number of coins to make a given value
description: Return fewest number of coins that you need to make up amount using bottom-up DP.

title: Optimal Strategy for a Game (Predict the Winner)
description: Two players take turns picking either front or end of array; determine if first player can win using minimax DP.

title: Optimal Binary Search Tree
description: Construct BST of keys with search frequencies such that total cost of all searches is minimized.

title: Palindrome Partitioning II (Minimum cuts needed)
description: Return minimum cuts needed for palindrome partitioning of string s in O(N^2) time.

title: Word Wrap Problem (DP)
description: Optimize extra space line wrapping using dynamic programming.

title: Mobile Numeric Keypad Problem
description: Count possible numbers of length N on numeric keypad moving to adjacent keys or staying on same key.

title: Boolean Parenthesization Problem
description: Count number of ways to parenthesize boolean expression with symbols T, F and operators &, |, ^ to evaluate to True.

title: Largest rectangular sub-matrix whose sum is 0
description: Find largest rectangular sub-matrix in 2D array having sum equal to 0 using 1D zero-sum hash map on column pairs.

title: Largest area rectangular sub-matrix with equal number of 1’s and 0’s
description: Find largest area sub-matrix with equal 1s and 0s by converting 0 to -1 and finding largest zero-sum sub-matrix.

title: Maximum sum rectangle in a 2D matrix
description: Find maximum sum rectangular submatrix in 2D matrix using Kadane's algorithm across row/column bounds in O(C*C*R).

title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock III (At most two transactions)
description: Find maximum profit completing at most two transactions using dynamic forward and backward profit arrays.

title: Interleaving String
description: Determine whether s3 is formed by an interleaving of strings s1 and s2 using 2D boolean DP.
